summary: With DELHIVERY_MAPS_NO_LOCAL_DATA=1 the batch workflows must be refused, not run: they cache every response and write addresses, and the switch promises no local API data. A --dry-run of each stays allowed because it makes no calls.
reason: The generated local-data policy only refuses sync and workflow archive, so a regen would let address clean and the other batch commands keep saving API data and addresses while doctor reports that store writes are off.
